BrochureContent.Content:
***3 BEDROOM SEMI DETACHED HOUSE***

Killian Lynch Auctioneers are pleased to present this beautiful 3 bedroom semi detached house with manicured front and rear gardens. The property whcih comprises of C.1,000 sq ft living accommodation is in turn key condition having been meticulously maintained by the current owner. This would be an ideal property for a first time buyer or for those seeking to move within walking distance of local ammenites. Located only C.5 minutes walking distance to Ballymakeera village, C.10 minutes’ drive to Macroom, C.20 minutes’ drive to Killarney town and a C.40 minutes’ drive to Cork city. 
Viewings highly advised


Services: Mains water & drainage, solid fuel heating (back boiler), ESB, oil fired central heating, fibre broadband
